card.text: Young A-type star 86 parsecs away, with a giant planet between two belts of dust.

sources.label: Desgrange et al. 2022
sources.quote: hosting a giant exoplanet orbiting at 57 au from the star between an inner and outer debris belt

introduction.text: HD 95086 is a young star often compared with the early Solar System. Its giant planet b circles about 57 au out, between an inner and an outer belt of dust.

sources.label: Desgrange et al. 2022
sources.quote: HD 95086 is a young nearby Solar System analog
